question: In 1867, Keshab Chandra Sen helped Atmaram Pandurang found the Prarthana Samaj in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bombay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prarthana Samaj **was founded in Bombay in 1867 by Atmaram Pandurang with the help of Keshab Chandra Sen.
 
• Prarthana Samaj was a reform movement aimed at promoting monotheism and social reforms such as widow remarriage, female education, and abolition of caste system.
 
• Keshab Chandra Sen, who was a Bengali reformer, played a key role in the establishment of Prarthana Samaj in Bombay and also helped in the formation of Brahmo Samaj in Calcutta.
 
• Calcutta, Poona, and Chennai also witnessed the emergence of similar reform movements during this period such as Brahmo Samaj, Arya Samaj, and Dravidian Movement respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Atmaram Pandurang was one of the two Indian co-founders of the Bombay Natural History Society, along with Sakharam Arjun. He also created the Prarthana Samaj.
 
• He was a brother of Sanskrit and Marathi scholar Dadoba Pandurang (9 May 1814 – 17 October 1882), who also graduated from Grant Medical College. In 1879, Atmaram Pandurang briefly held the position of Bombay sheriff.
